title: Empirical Directional Plausibility Check & Backtesting
disclaimer: PLAUSIBILITY CHECK ONLY: This module performs a qualitative directional plausibility check against 3 historical quick commerce events. Due to the small sample size (N=3 events, 12 tracked metric dimensions), this does not constitute statistical forecast accuracy or out-of-sample generalizability.
calibrationNote: Calibrate-vs-Test Split: Baseline parameters were calibrated against Event 1 (In-Sample Calibration: Zomato/Blinkit Acquisition), and evaluated against Events 2 & 3 as Out-of-Sample Test cases without refitting.

events.title: Event 1: Zomato Acquires Grofers / Rebrands to Blinkit
events.context: Zomato acquired distressed 10-minute grocery pioneer Grofers for ₹4,447 Cr ($570M). Critics predicted massive cash drain. Zomato slashed corporate overhead, integrated tech, and expanded dark stores from 400 to 600+.

trackedMetrics.actualDirection: Surged to ~40-42% in top metro clusters

trackedMetrics.predictedDirection: Shift from Question Mark to Star
trackedMetrics.actualDirection: High growth (>65%) with dominant relative share (>1.4x)

trackedMetrics.predictedDirection: Near break-even as store order density exceeds 1,200/day
trackedMetrics.actualDirection: Blinkit achieved positive adjusted EBITDA in Q4 FY24

trackedMetrics.predictedDirection: Rivals forced to match dark store expansion
trackedMetrics.actualDirection: Zepto & Swiggy raised growth capital to double dark store targets

events.varianceAnalysis: In-sample calibration confirmed the density hypothesis: dark-store geographic clustering reduces per-order rider transit distance from 2.4 km to 1.3 km, cutting unit delivery cost below ₹50.
events.source: Zomato Ltd Official Shareholder Letters (Q1 FY23 - Q4 FY24)

events.title: Event 2: Zepto's $665M Funding Surge at $3.6B Valuation
events.context: Zepto raised $665M from Avenir, Lightspeed, and Avra, tripling its valuation in 9 months to double dark stores from 350 to 700 to challenge Blinkit in Delhi-NCR.

trackedMetrics.actualDirection: Maintained ~29% share nationally, gained share in NCR

trackedMetrics.predictedDirection: Barrier to entry spikes for outside players
trackedMetrics.actualDirection: Pure-play standalone startups deterred; only Flipkart/JioMart can compete

trackedMetrics.predictedDirection: Monthly burn increases by 25-40% during fitout capex
trackedMetrics.actualDirection: Burn rose temporarily to $15-20M/month before store-level maturation
trackedMetrics.source: Zepto Form PAS-3 filings & Venture disclosures

trackedMetrics.predictedDirection: Price cuts across all categories to crush challengers
trackedMetrics.actualDirection: Partial mismatch: Zepto competed on speed (sub-10m) and Cafe rather than reckless deep price discounts
trackedMetrics.source: App Telemetry Invoices & Goldman Sachs Research 2024

events.varianceAnalysis: The model correctly predicted share defense and entrant deterrent moats, but overpredicted price discounting; in reality, Zepto differentiated on 'Zepto Cafe' and grocery curation rather than pure price cuts.
events.source: Zepto Series G Statutory MCA Filings, TechCrunch & Economic Times (2024)

events.title: Event 3: Industry-Wide Platform & Handling Fee Hikes
events.context: All major platforms simultaneously introduced and incrementally increased mandatory handling fees from ₹2 to ₹4, ₹6, and up to ₹10 during peak hours.

trackedMetrics.predictedDirection: Rivals match fee hikes within 2-3 weeks rather than undercut
trackedMetrics.actualDirection: Swiggy, Zepto, and Blinkit all instituted parallel fee ladders

trackedMetrics.predictedDirection: Order drop < 5% below ₹8 threshold (inelastic consumer demand)
trackedMetrics.actualDirection: Volumes dipped for ~7 days, then fully recovered to baseline

trackedMetrics.predictedDirection: Pure margin expansion of +₹3-6 per order
trackedMetrics.source: Motilal Oswal Quick Commerce Valuation Report

trackedMetrics.predictedDirection: Zero detectable permanent defection to physical Kiranas for urban basket
trackedMetrics.actualDirection: Convenience lock-in persisted despite nominal fees

events.varianceAnalysis: Validates the kinked-demand curve and oligopolistic price leadership: when dominant players raise platform fees to curb burn, competitors match rather than trigger a Bertrand price war.
events.source: Zomato & Swiggy disclosures & consumer invoice audits
